notes:
• Account sync now covers favourites, favourite folders, sports league follows and settings — not just playlists
• Saved passwords: when you sign in, you can unlock your playlist passwords with a 6-digit code emailed to you — they're kept locked on the server and only sent to your TV at sign-in
• Sign in with phone: there's now a QR code on the panel — scan it to open the approval page with the code already filled in
• Multiview: the sound now follows the highlight — moving to another screen gives it the sound, no need to press OK
• Mini player is bigger: 34% of the screen width (was 25%)
• Subtitles: when the 5 free downloads a day run out, a prompt now suggests creating your own free OpenSubtitles account for 20 a day
• Series: Back from a network tab (like Netflix) now leaves the tab instead of asking to exit the app
• Home: pressing Up from the first rail now opens the sidebar properly
• Sidebar: TV Guide now sits above Sports
• A broken "null" guide source is now removed automatically
